name: Minami-Awaji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minami-Awaji city emblem in blue and green: a blue and green ring enclosing a blue stylised sail.
history: Municipal flag of Minami-Awaji, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 January 2005.

features.role: Minami-Awaji city emblem — a blue and green ring enclosing a blue stylised sail
